FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the street-style fit check — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a top-down descent onto a flat plane on an 85mm short telephoto, framing with a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with LED tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth; grade as high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
